data.name: Krishnandan
data.gender_notes: Krishnandan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Krishnandan is a combination of two Sanskrit words, Krishna and Dan. Krishna means 'God' or 'Black' and Dan means 'wealth' or 'grace'. The name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Krishna. The name Krishnandan carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Krishnandan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Krishnandan is a devotional name, representing the deep faith and devotion towards Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Krishnandan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krishnandan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
